node.statement: Let P_J=sum_{j in J}P_j=R and A_J=S^A_R. By lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger, t<=e_full. Since R is a t-projection and ||R-I_A||<=t in the extended t-C*-algebra A, lem-maincb-full-corner-identification gives Co_R=Id_A and S^A_R=A. Hence A_J=A; and by def-compressed-corner its compressed unit is u_{A_J}=Co_R(R)=R.
